text: i didnt save it yet, i can, but basically i can show u what it was; actually, one thing u could add which would be nice to have for moments like this is right click and get a log of all the edits in memory to see what happens
resolution: Added Edit History to the model surface's right-click menu. It reads the bounded resident native journal in chronological undo/current/redo order, showing operation labels, vertex/triangle/authored-face counts, named part ranges and per-part face counts, hidden state, ownership faults, and memory use; Refresh re-reads host truth and Copy exports the complete JSON log. The native analysis/JSON boundary has focused Zig tests.
